# The full mod list of the server GOML's alphas are installed on, for the "your server's mods" test (report only,
# the alpha doesn't wait for it). One mod per line:
#
#   slug | Name | version
#
# slug: the Modrinth project (modrinth.com/mod/<slug>). When it doesn't exist or is another mod, Modrinth is searched
#       for the name.
# version: what the server's mod list shows for the mod. That version is used when Modrinth has it (also when it's
#       listed for another Minecraft version), otherwise the newest build for this Minecraft version.
# A mod that isn't on Modrinth can be a direct download link instead: https://.../file.jar | Name
# Add "| not-gametest" after the version to leave a mod out of the game test server (it still runs on the full server).
# Mods Modrinth doesn't have for Fabric are listed as skipped in the job summary, required dependencies are added.
# After updating the server's mods, update the versions here.
